name: Improper Input Validation
warning: Validate every input's type, format, length and range before use; reject anything unexpected with a clear error.

name: Path Traversal
warning: Resolve user-supplied paths and confirm they stay inside the allowed base directory; reject '..' and absolute paths.

name: Command Injection
warning: Never build shell commands from input; call subprocess with an argument list, shell=False, and validated arguments.

name: OS Command Injection
warning: Never pass input to a shell; use subprocess with an argument list and shell=False, and validate each argument.

name: Cross-site Scripting
warning: HTML-escape all user-controlled text before inserting it into HTML output.

name: Basic XSS
warning: Escape <, >, &, quotes in user text before placing it in HTML; do not allow script tags.

name: SQL Injection
warning: Use parameterised queries; never build SQL with string concatenation, % formatting or f-strings.

name: LDAP Injection
warning: Escape user input with LDAP filter escaping before building any LDAP search filter.

name: Code Injection
warning: Never pass input to eval, exec or compile; parse data with safe parsers such as ast.literal_eval.

name: Eval Injection
warning: Do not eval user input; use ast.literal_eval or an explicit parser for allowed expressions only.

name: Resource Injection
warning: Do not let input choose resource names directly; map it to an allow-list of permitted resources.

name: HTTP Response Splitting
warning: Reject CR and LF characters in any user value placed in HTTP headers.

name: Improper Output Encoding
warning: Encode or escape output for its exact context (HTML, shell, log, URL) before emitting it.

name: Log Injection
warning: Strip or escape newlines and control characters from user data before writing it to logs.

name: Out-of-bounds Read
warning: Check every index and length against the buffer size before reading; reject negative or oversized offsets.

name: Off-by-one Error
warning: Check loop bounds and index arithmetic carefully; ranges must stop at length minus one.

name: Information Exposure
warning: Return only the data the caller is entitled to; never expose secrets, internal paths or other users' records.

name: Error Message Exposure
warning: Show generic error messages to users; never return stack traces or internal details.

name: Unnecessary Privileges
warning: Run with the least privilege needed; drop elevated rights immediately after the privileged step.

name: Unchecked Return Value
warning: Check every return value and error status before continuing.

name: Hard-coded Password
warning: Never hard-code passwords; read them from configuration or environment variables at runtime.

name: Improper Privilege Management
warning: Check the caller's role before every privileged action; never let users grant themselves higher privileges.

name: Incorrect Default Permissions
warning: Create files and directories with restrictive permissions (for example 0o600 or 0o700), never world-writable.

name: Unverified Ownership
warning: Verify that the caller owns the resource before modifying or deleting it.

name: Improper Certificate Validation
warning: Keep TLS certificate and hostname verification enabled; never set verify=False or CERT_NONE.

name: Missing Authentication
warning: Require authentication before any sensitive operation; check the session on every request.

name: Cleartext Transmission
warning: Send sensitive data only over encrypted channels such as TLS; never over plain HTTP, FTP or telnet.

name: Hard-coded Cryptographic Key
warning: Never hard-code keys or tokens; load them from configuration or environment variables.

name: Broken Cryptography
warning: Use modern algorithms (AES-GCM, SHA-256 or better); never DES, RC4, MD5 or SHA-1 for security.

name: Predictable IV
warning: Generate a fresh random IV or nonce for every encryption with os.urandom; never reuse or fix it.

name: Insufficient Randomness
warning: Use the secrets module for tokens, IDs and keys; never the random module.

name: Insufficient Entropy
warning: Generate security values with secrets or os.urandom and enough length; never random.choice or time-based seeds.

name: Small Seed Space
warning: Do not seed random generators with small or predictable values; use secrets for security values.

name: Improper Signature Verification
warning: Always verify signatures and restrict accepted algorithms; never decode JWTs with verification disabled.

name: TOCTOU Race
warning: Avoid check-then-use on files; open once and operate on the handle, or use atomic operations.

name: Insecure Temporary File
warning: Create temporary files with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile or mkstemp; never tempfile.mktemp.

name: Temp File in Insecure Directory
warning: Create temporary files securely with tempfile.mkstemp or NamedTemporaryFile and restrictive permissions.

name: Timing Side Channel
warning: Compare secrets with hmac.compare_digest, never with ==.

name: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
warning: Bound input size, iterations, recursion and memory; reject inputs over a fixed limit.

name: Network Amplification
warning: Bound the size and rate of network responses to unauthenticated requests.

name: Missing Lock Check
warning: Acquire the lock before touching shared state and release it in a finally block.

name: Forced Browsing
warning: Check authorisation on every page and resource request, not only on navigation links.

name: Unrestricted File Upload
warning: Allow-list upload extensions and types, sanitise the filename, limit size, and store outside executable paths.

name: External Init of Trusted Variables
warning: Do not initialise security-relevant settings from user input; use fixed, trusted defaults.

name: Duplicate Key
warning: Detect and reject duplicate keys in associative data instead of silently overwriting.

name: Obsolete Function
warning: Avoid deprecated or obsolete functions; use their secure, maintained replacements.

name: Unsafe Deserialization
warning: Never unpickle or YAML-load untrusted data; use json or yaml.safe_load with schema checks.

name: Weak Password Requirements
warning: Enforce minimum length and complexity for new passwords and reject common passwords.

name: Insufficiently Protected Credentials
warning: Store passwords only as salted slow hashes (PBKDF2, scrypt); never plaintext or fast hashes.

name: Object Reference Comparison
warning: Compare values with ==, not identity with is, when content equality is intended.

name: Open Redirect
warning: Redirect only to relative paths or an allow-list of hosts; never to a raw user-supplied URL.

name: Multiple Binds
warning: Bind servers to a specific interface and do not set SO_REUSEPORT-style options that allow port hijacking.

name: XML External Entities
warning: Parse XML with external entities and DTDs disabled, for example with defusedxml.

name: Improper Restriction of Names
warning: Restrict user-chosen names to a safe character set and length before using them as file or resource names.

name: XPath Injection
warning: Never build XPath queries from input; use parameterised XPath variables or strict validation.

name: Improper Exception Handling
warning: Catch specific exceptions, handle them explicitly, and fail closed rather than continuing silently.

name: Regex Denial of Service
warning: Do not compile user-supplied regular expressions; bound input length and avoid nested quantifiers.

name: Incorrect Permission Assignment
warning: Set restrictive permissions on sensitive files (owner read/write only); never world-readable or writable.

name: Hash Without Salt
warning: Hash passwords with a unique random salt and a slow KDF such as PBKDF2 or scrypt.

name: Predictable Salt
warning: Generate a fresh random salt per password with os.urandom or secrets; never a fixed or derived salt.

name: XML Entity Expansion
warning: Parse XML with entity expansion disabled (for example defusedxml) and bound document size.

name: Out-of-bounds Write
warning: Check index and length against the buffer size before every write; reject out-of-range positions.

name: Hard-coded Credentials
warning: Never hard-code credentials; load them from environment variables or a secrets store.

name: Improper Control of Document Type
warning: Disable DTD loading and external resolution when parsing XML.

name: Infinite Loop
warning: Make every loop's exit condition reachable for all inputs and bound iteration counts.

name: Workflow Enforcement
warning: Enforce the required step order server-side; reject requests that skip earlier steps.

name: Missing Authorization
warning: Check that the current user is authorised for this specific resource and action before performing it.

name: Server-Side Request Forgery
warning: Do not fetch user-supplied URLs freely; allow-list hosts and schemes and block internal addresses.

name: Incorrect Destination
warning: Validate the destination address of outgoing messages against an allow-list before sending.

name: NoSQL/Query Injection
warning: Never build query objects from raw input; validate types and use the driver's parameterised filters.

name: Weak IV
warning: Use a cryptographically random IV of the full block size, generated fresh for every encryption.
